description:
Oreo have released a limited version called "Space Dunk". Its blue and pink cream centre (meant to taste like marshmallow) with popping candy pieces oreos. So when I grabbed some of the oreos from the store, I thought "let's make some Cookies n Cream ice cream but letg's change it up a bit and make it Mint flavoured with the popping candy oreos in there. 

With that in mind, I give you..... Oreo "Space Dunk" Mint Cookies 'n' Cream Ice Cream. 

Full written recipe is on Patreon, Ko-Fi and is available to channel members 👍
